column1: # One row per tracked keyword hit. Matched content is never recorded; the
# final column is the sha256 digest of the exact matched line bytes as emitted
# by `git grep -n -z` (the digest includes the line terminator).
# Line numbers are 1-based and must match current `git grep -n -z` output; an
# unrelated edit that shifts a listed line makes the row stale until updated.
# If the content at an existing (pattern, path, line) key changes, the live
# sha256 no longer matches and the row must be updated.
# Classes: fixture | doc | code | config. The class `real-risk` is forbidden
# and fails the check: real secrets must be removed, never suppressed.
# The check also fails on: a live hit with no row (new unclassified hit),
# a row with no live hit (deleted/stale entry), a live digest mismatch at the
# same key (content changed), a duplicate row, an unknown pattern id, an
# invalid class, or a non-sha256 digest. See scripts/check_secret_keyword_ledger.py.
# Current state: no tracked file matches the focused secret-keyword patterns
# the ledger is empty. Any future hit must be classified here before commit.
